entries.claim_boundary: This LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC tensor-principal theorem proves that S_AB=(alpha_B/2)partial_u Q_AB forgets a two-component u-independent tracefree corner tensor and that the minimal bulk Schouten pair is radical on a memory-inclusive carrier. It does not construct the conjugate corner momentum, angular/Coulombic Bondi recursion, boundary ghost/antifield/BFV quotient, I-/i0/I+ matching, P0/D_M charges, or any causal, particle, scattering, stability, positivity, unitarity or quantum result.

dispersion.statement: The obstruction is the zero mode of D_u, not a frequency-shell dispersion theorem.

lee_wald.statement: The minimal bulk Schouten pair (Q_AB,S_AB,C_AB) is not a nondegenerate memory-inclusive boundary phase space until a two-component tracefree corner coordinate and a conjugate corner momentum/constraint are supplied.

resonance.statement: No compact harmonic resonance carrier is identified.

bounded_or_finite_quasiperiodic.statement: The theorem is linear and asymptotic.

causal_retarded.statement: Retarded reconstruction requires declared corner data and is not matched through i0.

taub_maps.statement: No compact second-order Taub map is involved.

scope.boundaries: I+ retarded-time line with explicit endpoint/corner data
scope.carrier: leading p0 tracefree metric source Q_AB, leading auxiliary response S_AB, and p1 radiative response C_AB
scope.charge_sector: tracefree radiative principal Bondi jet; Coulombic aspects absent
scope.ell: local tensor principal relation; angular lower-order recursion remains open
scope.k: radial Bondi expansion, not compact momentum
scope.omega: smooth retarded-time profiles, including endpoint memory
scope.theory: linearized four-dimensional pure Weyl C^2 gravity in auxiliary-Schouten form
